jobs_spec_basis: corporate careers sends job seekers to the UKG job board; board search API returns all postings over HTTP
evidence: UKG board API read 2026-10-27 (19 postings, all listed): tech roles are Lead, Staff, Principal, Senior and manager. Applied AI Engineer (Grapevine, posted 2026-10-25) requires a track record of shipped AI results and proof of work, not entry-level, not counted. No entry SWE.
